summary: Kat's controlled runs gain 'reclassification' (owner approves each entry in-app; nothing posts at prepare), and a contract-driven vendor_line_rules table codes a vendor's invoice lines deterministically. Seeds Canyon Gate's three Bedrock agreement lines (management fee 5810, onsite staff 5855, website 5030). No journal entry, invoice, payment or budget changes.

preflight.name: vendor_line_rules does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name = 'vendor_line_rules'

preflight.name: Bedrock is a vendor
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM vendors WHERE id = 'e254e558-9285-4a02-9b35-7ea66d07ec91'

preflight.name: Canyon Gate has 5810, 5855 and 5030
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM chart_of_accounts WHERE community_id = 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003' AND account_number IN ('5810', '5855', '5030')

expected_changes: New table vendor_line_rules (service_role read/write, authenticated read).
Three Canyon Gate Bedrock rules: management fee -> 5810, onsite staff -> 5855, website/portal -> 5030.

verify.name: three Bedrock rules for Canyon Gate
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM vendor_line_rules WHERE community_id = 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003' AND vendor_id = 'e254e558-9285-4a02-9b35-7ea66d07ec91' AND is_active

verify.name: onsite staff codes to 5855
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM vendor_line_rules r JOIN chart_of_accounts a ON a.id = r.gl_account_id WHERE r.pattern LIKE 'onsite staff%' AND a.account_number = '5855'

verify.name: reclassification is an allowed run process
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'accounting_runs_process_check' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%reclassification%'
